subject: general
question: .................and UNICEF India signed a Statement of Intent (SOL) based on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) focused on children in April 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**NITI Aayog**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **NITI Aayog** is the premier policy think tank of the Government of India, providing both directional and policy inputs.
 
• It was established on January 1, 2015, replacing the Planning Commission.
 
• The primary aim of NITI Aayog is to foster cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives and mechanisms with the States on a continuous basis, recognizing that strong states make a strong nation.
 
• NITI Aayog's initiatives include the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) which are a collection of 17 global goals designed to be a "blueprint to achieve a better and more sustainable future for all".
